summary: Reference-aware artifact store and system-wide reclaim cleanup

delivery.outcome: Add a reference-aware artifact-store reclamation flow and an allowlisted system-wide reclaim analysis to fixos cleanup, so content-addressed digests referenced only by absolute paths inside manifests are protected and private user data is never a candidate.
nonGoals: No deletion outside the declared allowlist
No changes to existing docker/tmp/journal cleanup flows

architecture.decision: New diagnostics module fixos/diagnostics/artifact_store.py owns scanning and removal; fixos/cli/_cleanup_artifacts.py renders the inventory-first flow; cleanup_cmd.py exposes -c artifacts with --artifacts, --artifacts-min-age-days, --artifacts-receipt-dir, --artifacts-build-caches and --artifacts-system-wide.
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-135; cleanup returns to previous services only.

validation.evidence: 12 tests cover unreferenced/referenced digests, implicit absolute-path references, symlinks, receipts, private home directories, credential stores and receipt writing.
Live inventory lists 7222 entries with mount points, fresh entries and unexpected owners protected.
Governance check plus exact-head review before merge.
